title: Schedules, indexes, properties and quantity workflows
objective: Extend the verified CAD/BIM product with deterministic schedules, indexes, property-driven reporting and quantity workflows, using the Construction Graph as the authoritative information source and preserving frozen ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1.
acceptance_criteria: Schedule and index definitions are document-owned, deterministic and persist through save/open/replay.
Property-driven fields resolve from canonical model/Construction Graph semantics without a parallel source of truth.
Quantity workflows derive from canonical geometry/component/material semantics and remain revision-bound and reproducible.
Filters, grouping, sorting, calculated fields and presentation remain deterministic and explicitly typed where unsupported.
Web and Electron share the same semantic schedule/index/property/quantity contracts.
Existing CAD-PARITY-002..014 and COMPAT baselines remain green and byte-identical unless an explicitly reviewed migration is required.
Real engine/toolchain behavior remains behind existing adapter/worker boundaries.
Exact final head must be CI-verified, deployment/browser/Electron verified where applicable, and revision-bound before merge.
No protected architecture paths are modified.
non_goals: 4D/5D enterprise planning beyond the bounded quantity semantics required here.
risk_assumptions: CAD-PARITY-014 is VERIFIED and is the current interoperability baseline.
COMPAT-BIM-003 is VERIFIED and remains the BIM information baseline.
COMPAT-CAD-003 remains available as the documentation/quantity baseline.
COMPAT-IFC-001 remains available for exchange-backed property semantics.
Architecture v1.1 remains frozen throughout P015.
evidence_requirements: Representative Web/Electron parity fixtures for schedule and quantity workflows.
Canonical Construction Graph/property lineage checks demonstrating no parallel source of truth.
Regression proof that CAD-PARITY-002..014 and compatibility baselines remain green and byte-identical.
Exact-head deployment plus real-browser/Electron evidence where applicable.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering implementation, merge and post-merge verification.

transitions.reason: Release CAD-PARITY-015 as the next bounded schedules, indexes, properties and quantity slice following verified interoperability.
All declared P015 dependencies are verified on main. Assign implementation to the logical implementation agent and require stopping at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING for Architect review.

Implementation begins for CAD-PARITY-015 from the verified CAD-PARITY-014 mainline baseline. Scope is the bounded deterministic schedules, indexes, property-driven reporting and quantity workflows defined by Issue #110, preserving Construction Graph authority, shared Web/Electron semantics, adapter/worker boundaries and the PR_OPEN/VERIFYING stop gate.
